companyName: Prince George's County Blueprint Schools Program (Phase One)

sources.note: PGCPS Q1 2026 report page 4 states that PGCECP transferred ownership from Fengate and Gilbane to BBGI and that the operating program was in transition under BBGI; pages 11 and 14 confirm continuing facilities-management operations and the Elocen-to-Crockett subcontractor transition.

The rendered Developer Organizational Structure on PDF page 130 verifies Fengate PGCPS Holdco II, LLC at 75%, GD PGCPS Member, LLC at 25%, their 100%-owned Fengate Gilbane PGCPS Holdco I, LLC and the 100%-owned ProjectCo, Prince George's County Education & Community Partners, LLC.
PGCPS Q1 2021 report page 3 verifies December 18, 2020 as financial close and the six-school Phase One program.
Fengate's January 11, 2021 release verifies the PGCECP consortium roles, mid-December commercial and financial close, six-school scope and Core Infrastructure Fund III / LiUNA-affiliate attribution.
BBGI's January 29, 2026 release states it acquired a 100% equity interest in the six-school Prince George's County P3 and describes the operating social-infrastructure scope.
BCI's investment review identifies the schools transaction as closed in February 2026 and confirms BBGI's 100% interest; it also establishes BCI's ownership of BBGI.
PGCPS's live program page confirms the phased P3 program and prevents conflating Phase One with later Blueprint Schools phases.

modelEvidenceCorrections: Retire Fengate's 75% and Gilbane Development's 25% ownership periods at February 2026 and add BBGI as 100% current owner; do not leave Fengate active.
Use December 18, 2020 as financial close and manager entry date; January 11, 2021 is the announcement date.
Treat February 2026 as month-precision for the BBGI close because BBGI announced acquisition January 29 while BCI labels the close February.
Keep PGCECP/Phase One as the canonical operating concession and keep Blueprint Schools Phase II separate.
releaseRequirement: Keep the Phase One ProjectCo active, retire Fengate 75% and Gilbane Development 25% at the February 2026 ownership close, add BBGI as 100% current owner under ultimate BCI ownership, correct financial close to December 18, 2020, and preserve the six-school boundary.
